PerQseal Elite vascular closure system, used in large-bore arterial procedures.
The system "provides sutureless, large-bore vascular closure following structural heart and endovascular procedures performed with 14–22F sheaths," per a
. "Its fully bioabsorbable patch seals arteriotomies up to 26F from within the vessel, enabling near-instantaneous hemostasis and leaving nothing permanent behind."
A single-arm study found PerQseal Elite was associated with 0% major complications and a mean time to hemostasis of less than one minute.
